name: Another Dimension
source: The protagonist wakes up in a strange world, alongside a group of people, none of them remembers anything, not even their own names. Soon, they’ll discover that this world is nothing like the one they came from. Filled with creatures of all kinds living in a delicate balance, the protagonist must uncover why they’re here… and figure out how to set things right.
